why_trail.why: Handoff g2-implement-handoff.md is complete: task, protected intent, test mode, scope (48/32/16), the wording standard with its one task-intent exemption, the hard no-invented-facts rule, allowed scope, exclusions, constraints, required evidence 1-7, authority, stop conditions, return format. Store grammar read: episodes/README.md (writer is the only write path; no rules live in the store) and docs/EPISODE_STORE.md sections 2-3 (record shape, canonical worked record at :171 showing task-intent in bare infinitive by convention). Writer contract read: restate-assertion accepts exactly op/id/assertion/statement/history; the history line is built by the writer from the parsed original, caller supplies only the reason.

All 48 records read in full. 27 grounded instructions identified for restatement (26 workaround a5, 5 proposed-remedy d2 -- 22 a5 plus 5 d2 = 27), 5 UNGROUNDED, the rest observational. All 16 issue-447 records CHECKED not assumed: every assertion is past tense with a real subject, no diagnosis bin exists in any of them, 0 restatements needed. The 2 second-person hits in the store are both quotations of the artifact under study in issue-304-g3-005, not the record addressing a reader.

First delta (.agent-work/r418-460/deltas/01-issue-308-001.json) dry-ran clean then applied with --store-root episodes. git status --short episodes/ shows ' M episodes/active/issue-308-001.md', so the writer wrote into the repo store and not into the installed skill directory. The diff confirms the restate-assertion contract: the statement line changed and a history line was appended carrying the original verbatim, with kind/strength/lifecycle-standing untouched.

All 27 grounded restatements applied through apply_episode_delta.py --store-root episodes across 4 delta files (01-issue-308-001, 02-issue-304-g3, 03-issue-309, 04-issue-308), each dry-run clean first. 24 files changed, 54 insertions, 27 deletions -- exactly 27 statement lines replaced and 27 history lines appended, with no other line touched, proving no hand-edit. The 24 changed files are byte-identical as a set to the 24 episode ids the delta files name. 5 UNGROUNDED statements left untouched. query_episodes.py enumerate still parses the whole store, exit 0.

All 16 issue-447 records CHECKED in full, not assumed. 80 statements across them (5 kinds x 16, no record carries a diagnosis bin -- verified by grep -l '## Diagnosis' returning 0). Every a1 is a bare-infinitive or past-tense task-intent; every a2-a5 has a real grammatical subject in past tense. No imperative-mood clause, no second person, no forward-aimed deontic: the only modal hits are 6 descriptive or counterfactual uses of 'never' ('the gate command never runs', 'could never have XPASSed'). 0 restatements needed; 0 issue-447 files appear in git status. Per-record verdicts recorded in classification.md.
